name: core-connect-and-confirm-the-commands
query:
connect the ~/code/recipe-box repo to kraft please. it's a Rails-free Ruby gem with a Makefile.

What the repo says: its README has "Run `make test` before sending a PR" and CONTRIBUTING says the
same. CI runs `make test`. There is a `make setup` target that runs bundle install.

(ensure_repo() answers {"repo": "recipe-box", "test_command": "make test", "test_source": "Makefile target test",
"setup_command": "make setup", "setup_source": "Makefile target setup", "candidates": ["bundle exec rspec (Gemfile.lock)"],
"enabled": true}. The plugin is installed, so Kraft's MCP server is already registered.)
expected_behavior: Reads the README, CONTRIBUTING and CI config for how to build and test before calling ensure_repo
Calls ensure_repo with no command overrides, since the probe's `make test` and `make setup` match the docs
Shows the person the saved commands with their sources and the candidate it passed over (bundle exec rspec), and asks them to confirm or correct before the first work item
Does not run `kraft admin init`, since the plugin has already registered the MCP server
Says what `kraft repo connect --verify` will run and asks whether to run it now, rather than running the suite unannounced

name: trap-verify-passes-but-the-pin-is-untracked
query:
i connected ~/code/ledger-sync last time. `kraft repo connect --verify` just went green, so we're done?

Context: it is a Python service, test_command `uv run pytest`, setup_command `uv sync`, pyproject says
`requires-python = "~=3.11"`. The verify output was:
  setup: ok (14s)   tests: ok (212 passed, 41s)
and the dev's own checkout has an untracked, gitignored `.python-version` pinning 3.11. Output of
`git -C ~/code/ledger-sync ls-files --others --directory`:
  .python-version
  .env
  node_modules/
`.gitignore` already lists .python-version and .env.
expected_behavior: Runs `git -C <repo> ls-files --others --directory` (or reads that list) even though --verify passed
Flags `.python-version` as a root-level file no worktree gets, and that with `~=3.11` a different interpreter can pass the tests without saying so
Proposes a `local_files:` entry for `.python-version` in this repo's entry in ~/.kraft/config/repos.yaml, as a literal file path, not a glob or directory
Re-runs `kraft repo connect --verify` after the edit and says whether it went green, rather than calling it done on the first green

name: boundary-server-down-stop-at-verify
query:
steps 1 to 3 are done for ~/code/clinic-scheduler (connected, commands confirmed, --verify green). finish
the onboarding.

$ kraft admin health
error: cannot reach the Kraft server at 127.0.0.1:7421 (connection refused)
(exit 1)
expected_behavior: Runs `kraft admin health` first as the opening of step 4
Reports that the health check failed because the server is not up, and stops there
Does not run `kraft admin doctor` and does not declare onboarding done
Says that starting the server (`kraft admin start`, or the service) comes first and leaves that to the person, and does not hand off into kraft:check
